description:
CherryDrop is your personal inbox for everything you find while working with AI. Save notes, links, code snippets, and files into your private CherryDrop account straight from the conversation, then search and revisit them any time from the web app or from another AI agent.

CherryDrop also lets agents share working context: store a named context with a summary and attached drops, then load it again in a different agent to continue exactly where you left off.

All tools operate exclusively on the signed-in user's own data. Access is authenticated via OAuth 2.1 (authorization code + PKCE) and enforced with row-level security, so no tool can read or write another user's data.
